name: Grass Pledge
effect: User picks which stat to roll with. Move is Physical/Special in accordance with the choice. Hazard. Sets up Grass Pledge Hazard on the opponent's battlefield, which triggers every time a victim switches to another foe than the last one they targeted. When triggered, they inflict -2 Initiative on the victim (Max one per victim). TThis effect lasts 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokemon chants to invoke the power of Grass. It's pledge is heard, then the soil trembles and the ground crumbles as vegetation rises to grapple anyone in the field.
